messages:
Maya: Quick check — RFC review tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final roster and confirmations. Two asks: (1) authors confirm pre-read uploaded, (2) reviewers confirm availability or request swaps by EOD today.

Devin: Confirmed. I'll take the infra placement RFC. Pre-read: https://docs.redwood/rfcs/infra-placement.md

Aj: Travel in the morning — can swap my slot with @Sophia? If not, I can do async notes.

Sophia: I can swap with @Aj, no problem. Taking the second slot.

Maya: Swap approved. @Aj please update your RFC thread to note the swap so chairs see it.

Aj: Done — added "author swap: Aj -> Sophia" to the RFC thread and pinned the pre-read.

Lina: Heads up — Security RFC needs to be earlier if possible. Several reviewers only free in the first half. Can we reorder?

Devin: +1 to security first. Also propose we budget 15m for follow-ups; last time it spilled over.

Maya: Proposed short agenda: 
```
1) Security RFC — 20m (author: @Lina)
2) Infra placement — 15m (author: @Devin)
3) Storage schema — 10m (author: @Sophia)
4) Open triage / follow-ups — 15m
```
If no objections I'll post this as the meeting agenda.

Sophia: Looks good to me.

infra-bot: Calendar event updated: "RFC Review — Mar 12" attendees: Maya, Devin, Lina, Sophia, Aj. Link: https://cal.redwood/ev/12345

Maya: Quick author checklist reminder: add a 3-bullet summary at the top of your RFC and bold any explicit decisions needed (e.g., **Decision: accept new shard key**). Keeps reviews focused.

Aj: Noted — I'll add the summary tonight.

Lina: Summary added and pre-read uploaded. Pinging reviewers for anything specific they'd like covered.

Devin: I'll skim and flag comments inline. If something's urgent, tag me with @Devin.

Maya: Thanks all — I'll send a final reminder at 17:00 PT. If anyone has a hard conflict with the reordered agenda, shout now and we'll reshuffle.

Sophia: All good from me, thanks!
